cards.input_contract_proposed: Strictly prior aligned normalized prices, formation boundaries and known pair identities.

Independent licensed NVDA/AMD cointegration alternative materially differs from distance selector.
Local multi-stock histories/actions/universe and historic locates are unqualified by this review.
Simultaneous leg/fill policy, gross/net/beta drift and borrow/financing costs remain explicit prerequisites.

cards.input_contract_proposed: Historical volume, point-in-time shares outstanding and market cap, security classifications and publication lag.
cards.output_contract_proposed: As-of turnover score, eligible universe, rank/quantile and signed portfolio intent; execution uses separate risk/liquidity checks.

cards.horizon: Yearly rebalance with trailing volume window; exact turnover scaling needs source/runtime audit.
blockers: Liquidity as return predictor is not an execution algorithm or measured spread/impact improvement.
PIT shares outstanding, market cap, fundamentals and historic small-cap membership unavailable/unqualified locally.
HasFundamentalData alone must not be accepted as proof of every claimed ADR/ETF/fund exclusion; audit exact identifiers.
Mean-daily versus annual volume terminology and split-consistent numerator/denominator require explicit units.
Illiquid short fills, locates/recalls, market impact and concentration can invalidate cheap-fill assumptions.
simple_controls: High versus low turnover with identical cost/risk policy
Long-only low-turnover as a separately named adaptation

cards.input_contract_proposed: Prior formation returns, train-only empirical marginals/model parameters and causal current aligned observations.
cards.output_contract_proposed: Selected pair, model family/version, fit cutoff, conditional mispricing values, signed leg proposal and invalid-fit reason.
cards.asof_contract: Every required input availability and formation/fit cutoff must precede decision; next eligible fill cannot precede decision. Same-bar fill semantics not qualified.
cards.horizon: Monthly formation refresh with trailing12-month data; daily decision cadence in displayed method.
blockers: Copula family chosen by AIC is statistical-model selection, not trading-strategy selection or market red/green state.
Article names QQQ/XLK after copula selection but calls GLD/DGL the same pair in cointegration section; common input comparison unverified.
Boundary clipping, tau/theta admissibility, unstable hedge ratios and zero/negative beta require synthetic checks.
No complete qualified licensed implementation; SciPy/statsmodels mathematical helpers do not establish locked full runtime.
Historical ETF inception, adjustments, multi-leg borrow/fills/costs and out-of-sample fit stability remain blockers.
simple_controls: Same frozen pair/date/cost copula versus linear spread
Same model with fixed rather than selected family

preserved_negative_baseline.finding: Causal fixed NVDA/AMD mechanism adaptation failed both improvement screens; negative growth and prolonged underwater period. Do not reinterpret pair hold as prospective stock-selection skill.

best_next_question.question: Can one historical decision be reconstructed with known eligible universe, action-consistent inputs and every availability timestamp? Stop on missing evidence before scores or orders.
